name: KiCad Track Gloss
description: Gloss one or more selected PCB tracks in a single click.
description_full: Smart Octo testing release for KiCad 10. Each obstacle becomes one conservative octolinear polygon built from the maximum sourced clearance, while the moving polyline retains only its real copper width. The engine contracts complete selected connections continuously, reconstructs clean 0/45/90 degree copper, repeats deterministic multi-net passes to a fixed point or the total budget, and performs one global KiCad DRC comparison when enabled. A separate diagnostic action can draw sourced and effective obstacle envelopes on a removable User layer. Selection authorizes modification; KiCad locks and native routing authority remain protected. The plugin never saves the board automatically. The standalone adaptation was created by ChatGPT/Codex (OpenAI), inspired by and reusing part of DrAndyHaas's code, and is maintained by Frantz.
